_doc: What a landing would LOSE or have to MOVE, per provenance, plus generic couplings that apply to every repository. scan.sh evaluates the entries of every detected provenance and the generic ones (path / dep / code, same matching as `detect`; `content` filters a path match). plan.py lists them on the 'What would be lost or must move' line of a report-only Vision, and as [assumed] lines in a plan. kind: data | files | baas | cron | platform-api | config | process. Effort S/M/L/XL as in decision-rules.md.

generic.what: SQLite database on local disk (lost at every redeploy on Clever: the disk is ephemeral)
generic.target: PostgreSQL add-on (encrypted) + data migration (scripts/migrate-sqlite.py, row counts proven); or SQLite on an FS Bucket, one instance, never in HDS

generic.what: uploaded files written to local disk (lost at every redeploy)
generic.target: Cellar (S3) + code change at each call site; existing files copied with scripts/migrate-files.py --source-dir (SHA-256 manifest)

generic.what: crontab entries (not run anywhere on Clever unless rewritten)
generic.target: clevercloud/cron.json + templates/cron/ (empty job environment, one instance)

generic.what: systemd service (ExecStart, Environment=): the process and its variables
generic.target: the app's start command (runtime variables) + Clever environment variables (names only)

generic.what: supervisor programs (long-running processes next to the web server)
generic.target: CC_WORKER_COMMAND_n on the app (not with Docker)

netlify.target: Next.js middleware on the Node server (no native geolocation)

netlify.what: Netlify Forms (data-netlify): submissions stored by Netlify
netlify.target: a form route in the app + transactional e-mail (SMTP)
an explicit variable set on Clever

firebase.target: kept on Firebase for a first landing (landing A), or a rewrite to PostgreSQL (L)
kept (landing A), or auth in the app / Keycloak (L)
kept (landing A), or Cellar + file migration (M)

firebase.what: Cloud Functions (firebase-functions; started by `firebase functions:shell`, not an app)
firebase.target: routes of the app or Clever Tasks

firebase.what: App Hosting injects the Firebase config and secrets (initializeApp() without arguments)
firebase.target: explicit firebaseConfig from NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* set before the build; secrets as Clever variables

fly-render.what: Fly Machines API (the app starts Fly Machines): not portable
fly-render.target: clevercloud/cron.json or Clever Tasks — a rewrite

fly-render.what: Fly volume ([[mounts]]): data on a persistent disk
fly-render.target: FS Bucket mounted on that path (one instance, never in HDS) or a database

fly-render.what: render.yaml variables (generated secrets, values to provide, database properties)
fly-render.target: env-safe.sh generate / values to provide / add-on variables

fly-render.what: a static site service (build + publish dir, SPA rewrite)
fly-render.target: Clever static runtime (CC_BUILD_COMMAND, CC_WEBROOT, Caddyfile for the SPA fallback)
FS Bucket (one instance, never in HDS) or Cellar

railway.target: Clever add-on variables (code change: fall back to POSTGRESQL_ADDON_URI)

railway.what: a Railway volume may hold data the repository does not show (e.g. uploaded media)
railway.target: Cellar or an FS Bucket — check the project's volumes

platformsh-upsun.target: CC_WORKER_COMMAND_n, or clevercloud/cron.json for the scheduler
FS Bucket (PHP) or Cellar + file migration

platformsh-upsun.what: platformsh/laravel-bridge derives the database config and APP_KEY from Platform.sh variables
platformsh-upsun.target: Laravel DB_* → MYSQL_ADDON_* / POSTGRESQL_ADDON_*; APP_KEY generated (env-safe.sh)

kubernetes.what: Kubernetes Secrets (values not in the repository)
kubernetes.target: Clever environment variables (names only; values provided)
a database add-on, Cellar or an FS Bucket

kubernetes.what: StatefulSets (databases or caches run in the cluster)

terraform-aws.what: AWS Lambda functions (scale to zero, event triggers)
terraform-aws.target: a small HTTP server calling the handler (S per handler), or Clever Tasks
routes of the app on Clever
a rewrite to PostgreSQL (L), or kept on AWS

terraform-aws.what: remote Terraform state (cloud {} / backend): what is really deployed is not in the repository

gcp-azure.what: production settings switched on by WEBSITE_HOSTNAME (App Service only): elsewhere the dev settings load
gcp-azure.target: an explicit switch (e.g. APP_ENV=production) set on Clever

beanstalk-amplify.target: PostgreSQL add-on rewrite (M), or kept on AWS (partial landing)

beanstalk-amplify.what: static files served by Elastic Beanstalk's nginx
beanstalk-amplify.target: served by the app (express.static) or the static runtime

digitalocean.what: an APP_KEY value committed in the App Platform spec
digitalocean.target: rotate it; a new APP_KEY generated on Clever (env-safe.sh)

digitalocean.what: managed databases declared in the App Platform spec
digitalocean.target: the matching Clever add-on + data migration

digitalocean.what: build and run commands of the App Platform spec
digitalocean.target: the runtime's start rules (e.g. CC_WEBROOT for PHP)

cloudflare.what: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite at the edge), used through bindings
cloudflare.target: PostgreSQL add-on + SQL conversion (L), or SQLite on an FS Bucket, one instance (M)
environment variables + clients in a Node adapter
lost (no equivalent): headers or a geo-IP library

coolify-dokku-caprover.what: DOKKU_SCALE: the processes really started (others at 0)
coolify-dokku-caprover.target: only those processes on Clever; the others optional

appwrite-pocketbase.what: PocketBase data in pb_data (SQLite on disk)
appwrite-pocketbase.target: FS Bucket mounted for pb_data, one instance, never in HDS (no FS Bucket with Docker: native Go build)

appwrite-pocketbase.what: PocketBase listens on its own port (--http 0.0.0.0:8090)
